verdict.rationale: Reclaim's Scheduling Links let others book time across your team's availability on "one, or many, calendars," so multi-host booking links are documented. The evidence does not say these links only show slots when every required host is free, rather than round-robin or any-host availability. Smart Meetings finding times across all attendees is internal meeting scheduling, not a bookable event. missing for 10: explicit collective/all-hosts-required availability semantics, required vs optional host configuration, sales-team booking-page documentation, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a sales lead, I can offer collective events that only show slots when every required host is free

citations.quote: Scheduling Links enable you to send links to you and your team's availability, allowing others to book time across one, or many, calendars.
